cards.text: It's the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and Jesus's disciples come to Him with a question about the Passover. I respect a crew that plans ahead. I once preheated the oven AFTER the dough was ready, and that dough just sat there STARING at me.

cards.question: On the first day of the Feast of Unleavened Bread, what do the disciples ask Jesus about the Passover?

answers.text: Where He wants them to prepare it
Who He wants them to invite
How long the feast should last

cards.text: Jesus sends them into the city to a certain man, with the Teacher's message already worked out for them. The one time I delivered a message without the words worked out, I rolled up to a new baker, said 'COOKIES?' and just stood there.

cards.question: Jesus tells the disciples to say the Teacher will keep the Passover with His disciples at the man's ___.

cards.text: Here's the Teacher's message: 'My time is near. I will keep the Passover with My disciples at your house.' So the disciples do just what Jesus directed and get the Passover ready.
When evening comes, Jesus is reclining at the table with the twelve disciples. Then, while they're eating, He says, 'Truly I tell you, one of you will betray Me.'

cards.question: When Jesus says one of the twelve will betray Him, the disciples take the news calmly.

cards.text: Deeply grieved, they ask Him one after another, 'Surely not I, Lord?' It's like when the smoke alarm goes off in my bakery and every baker slowly turns around to check their OWN tray.

cards.question: Jesus gives a clue about who will betray Him: the one who has dipped his hand into the ___ with Him.

cards.text: Then Jesus calls Himself the Son of Man and says, 'The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him…' But He's not finished, friend, and the next part is heavy.

cards.question: Jesus says the Son of Man will go 'just as it is written about Him…' What does that mean?

answers.text: What happens to Him was already in Scripture
His words will all be written down later
His name is kept in the temple records

cards.question: Jesus says it would be better for the man who betrays Him if he had not been born.

cards.text: Then Judas speaks up, one of the Twelve and the one who would betray Jesus. Same question, one word swapped: 'Surely not I, Rabbi?'

cards.question: Judas asks Jesus, 'Surely not I, Rabbi?' How does Jesus answer him?

cards.text: While they're still eating, Jesus takes bread, speaks a blessing, breaks it and gives it to the disciples. Slow down with me here, friend, because what He says next matters.

cards.question: Jesus gives the broken bread to the disciples and tells them to take and eat. What does He say the bread is?

cards.text: Then He takes the cup, gives thanks and hands it over with words that leave nobody at that table out: 'Drink from it, all of you.'

cards.question: Jesus says the cup is His ___ of the covenant, poured out for many for the ___ of sins.

cards.text: Then Jesus tells them He won't drink of this fruit of the vine from now on. But hold on, friend, because He doesn't leave it there.

cards.question: Jesus says He won't drink of the fruit of the vine from now on. Until when?

answers.text: Until He drinks it anew in His Father's kingdom
Until the Passover is kept again in Jerusalem
Until the Sabbath day has come and gone

cards.text: Then they go out to the Mount of Olives, near Jerusalem (Acts 1:12). Walk with me, friend.

cards.question: Before they go out to the Mount of Olives, Jesus and the disciples sing a hymn.

cards.text: Then Jesus says, 'This very night you will all fall away on account of Me.' ALL of them, and He backs it up with Scripture.

cards.question: Jesus quotes Scripture: when the Shepherd is struck, the sheep of the flock will be ___.
Jesus doesn't stop at the hard news. What does He tell the disciples He'll do after He has risen?

answers.text: Go ahead of them into Galilee
Go ahead of them into Samaria
Go ahead of them into Syria

cards.text: Then Peter, one of the Twelve, speaks up: 'Even if all fall away on account of You, I never will.' Friend, that is a BOLD thing to say with all your friends standing right there.

cards.question: Peter says he'll never fall away. Jesus tells him that this very night, before the rooster crows, Peter will ___ Him three times.

cards.text: Peter doubles down: 'Even if I have to die with You, I will never deny You.' That's me with the timer already beeping, promising LOUD with my whole mustache that I will NEVER burn a batch.

cards.question: Peter is the only disciple who says he'll never deny Jesus.

cards.text: Big promises, out on the Mount of Olives. Hold on to them, friend, because this story is far from finished.
